'''Stripped Down''' is a ship [[Experimental Effects|Experimental Effect]] that replaces components with lighter alternatives and removes non-essential parts. It reduces the receiving module's mass by '''10%'''.<ref name="inara">[https://inara.cz/elite/experimentaleffects/ INARA: Engineering — Experimental effects], accessed 14 September 2026.</ref>

== Effect ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Attribute
! Modifier
|-
| Module mass
| -10%
|}

The modifier applies only to the module, not to the ship's total mass. Its practical effect therefore depends on how much of the ship's mass that module represents. Removing 10% from a heavy Power Plant or set of Thrusters can matter more than the same percentage on a light weapon.

Stripped Down has no direct listed penalty to module integrity, power draw, heat, distributor use, capacity, or output. Its cost is the Experimental Effect slot: fitting it prevents the module from using a competing effect.

== Compatible modules ==

Stripped Down is available for:<ref name="inara" />

* [[Shield Generator|Shield Generators]];
* [[Thrusters]];
* [[Frame Shift Drive|Frame Shift Drives]];
* [[Power Plant|Power Plants]];
* [[Power Distributor|Power Distributors]];
* [[Shield Cell Bank|Shield Cell Banks]];
* conventional Engineer-compatible weapons, including [[Beam Laser|Beam]], [[Burst Laser|Burst]], and [[Pulse Laser|Pulse Lasers]], [[Multi-Cannon|Multi-cannons]], [[Plasma Accelerator|Plasma Accelerators]], [[Fragment Cannon|Fragment Cannons]], [[Cannon|Cannons]], [[Railgun|Railguns]], [[Mine Launcher|Mine Launchers]], [[Torpedo Pylon|Torpedo Pylons]], and seeker or dumbfire [[Missile Rack|Missile Racks]].

Mining tools and experimental weapons do not normally accept the effect. Specialised variants should be checked in the Engineer interface.

Current values are recorded by INARA and the maintained Elite Dangerous Wiki.<ref name="wiki">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Stripped_Down Elite Dangerous Wiki: Stripped Down], accessed 14 September 2026.</ref>

Experimental Effects are installed once rather than progressed through Grades 1–5. The appropriate Engineer must support the module family and be visited in person; [[Remote Engineering]] cannot add or replace an Experimental Effect.

== Selection guidance ==

Stripped Down is useful when lowering total ship mass supports the build's primary goal:

* improving jump range on an exploration or transport ship;
* reducing the mass carried by a racing or high-performance ship;
* helping a mass-sensitive set of Thrusters operate farther down its performance curve;
* trimming several heavy modules after their primary Engineering Blueprints are complete.

The effect is less compelling when the modified module is already light or when a competing effect directly improves the ship's mission. For example:

* an FSD may gain more useful range from [[Mass Manager]];
* Thrusters may favour Drag Drives or Drive Distributors;
* a Power Plant may need thermal or output changes;
* a weapon may gain more from damage, ammunition, thermal, or utility effects;
* a defensive module may favour integrity or shield-performance effects.

Use an outfitting planner to compare the change to total laden and unladen mass. A 10% module reduction should not be interpreted as a 10% increase in jump range, speed, or manoeuvrability.
